x: Michael Franks, the Youths winner, was most impressive scoring the maximum 100 points. The battle for 2nd place was not so clear cut though, Nigel Bacon and Richard King tying at 89 points with Mick Harvey just one point behind

Dave Rees got us away to a fine start handing over with a lead to Mick Franks who increased this with great power and completed a great batton change with Arnold Bent who ran superbly to give John Hamilton a clear lead over the rest of the field.
